svg.title: Two enlarged cross-sections of one contact hole beside a transistor gate, one above the other. Before the step a cross-hatched grey metal fills the hole and covers the flat top. After it the metal and the thin dark film under it are gone from the top: the metal is left only in the hole, its top flush with the flat oxide around it.

svg.text: The tungsten and the liner are polished
off the field, down to the cap oxide.
After: a tungsten plug, flush with the cap oxide
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
